arguments.value: Endorsement Agreement dated October 30, 2017, between National Football League Alumni - Northern California Chapter (NFLA-NC), National Football League Alumni, Inc. (NFLA), and Food For Athletes, Inc. / Gridiron BioNutrients™ (collectively the Company). NFLA grants the Company a worldwide, three-year license from November 1, 2017 through November 2, 2020 to use the NFLA Identification and Pro Football Legends Logo only for approved advertising, marketing, and promotion of specified products, subject to prior written approval and quality-control conditions. In return, the Company pays a $35,000 one-time license fee to NFLA-NC, a $10,000 promotional fee to NFLA in four quarterly payments beginning in 2018, and $0.05 per Unit sold of Licensed Products to NFLA-NC, with Units defined for the listed products. The Company also agrees to provide certain product commitments, a call center for members, indemnification, and insurance; NFLA-NC agrees to make good-faith efforts to provide certain member appearances and NFLA agrees to sponsor-promote the Company as specified in Exhibit B. After termination, the Company must stop using the NFLA Identification, with a limited 90-day inventory sell-off period. The agreement is governed by California law and disputes must be arbitrated under AAA Commercial Arbitration Rules in or near Hayward, California.
